title: CloudFront caches content
summary: CloudFront is a content delivery service. It can serve cached copies from edge locations nearer to visitors.
introduction: CloudFront is a content delivery service. It can serve cached copies from edge locations nearer to visitors. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: CloudFront is a content delivery service. It can serve cached copies from edge locations nearer to visitors.

blocks.code:
Visitor -> nearby edge cache
Cache miss -> approved origin
Response -> visitor
blocks.title: CloudFront caches content

blocks.text: A cache hit can avoid another trip to the origin. Cache rules determine how updates become visible.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Choose whether a logo or a private account page should be freely cached.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not cache private personalised data with public cache rules.
